title: The account of one of the locals who was present at the wedding ceremony that was attacked by the US in the Kohstak region.
text:
The account of one of the locals who was present at the wedding ceremony that was attacked by the US in the Kohstak region."

" SOT, Eye witness in the wedding: "They hit that house, the house of Mohammad Rasul, my husband's cousin Osman's house, which was his grandmother's house. My hands and feet are still shaking; may God have mercy. It is unclear how many people were in the house or how many are underneath; only God knows. This house isn't near any military site at all; it's as if it was a perfect target for four missiles to hit a house where a wedding was happening with so many people. May God have mercy.
